title: Research on Automatic Identification and Rating of Ferrite-Pearlite Grain Boundaries Based on Deep Learning
summary: U-Net segments ferrite boundaries and infers hidden pearlite boundaries; the three-circle intercept method rates grain size. 2,000 annotated images from 200 metallographic samples; four steel microstructure sample types; rating accuracy >90%, deviation <0.5 grade and runtime 2 s vs manual 30 min. Claim is automated ferrite-pearlite grain-size rating, not improved steel properties.
ai_technology: U-Net segments ferrite/pearlite boundaries; image measurements are converted to grain-size ratings.
